en: Colorized historic postcard view of a harbor with numerous sailing ships and small boats along both quays. Traditional houses and warehouses line the waterfront, and a church tower or similar structure is visible in the distant background. The scene is tranquil with one person rowing a small boat in the foreground. The lower part of the card is left blank for writing, with printed red text giving the place name and publisher information.
